# 07 Parse annotations, generics, namespaces, notes and direction

## Outcome

`parseClassDiagram` recognizes the rest of the structural syntax: `<<annotation>>` markers,
`~generic~` parameters, `namespace Name { ... }` blocks, `note` / `note for X`, and
`direction TB|BT|LR|RL`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `<<interface>>` parses both inside a class block (as its own line) and standalone
  (`<<interface>> Shape`), attaching to the right class; arbitrary text like `<<Service>>` works.
- [ ] `class Square~Shape~` and a member typed `List~int~` parse with the generic parameter
  captured, and nested forms (`Map~String, List~int~~`) either parse or produce a diagnostic —
  document which, in the implementation.
- [ ] `namespace BaseShapes { class Triangle ... class Square ... }` parses to a namespace naming
  both classes, whose class declarations still appear as normal classes in the document.
- [ ] `note "free text"` and `note for Duck "attached text"` parse into distinct note forms, the
  second carrying its target class name.
- [ ] `direction RL` parses into the document; absent, the document carries the default.
- [ ] An unterminated `namespace` block returns `document: null` plus an error diagnostic.
- [ ] Everything from ticket 01 still parses — its tests pass unmodified.

## Test seam

`parseClassDiagram(source: string): ParseResult` — unit level, extending ticket 01's test file.
